snippet.title: Release Date Trailer - IMAGO SEASON
snippet.description:
https://s.team/a/4207140/
IMAGO SEASON comes out in three weeks! Don't miss the launch discount when it arrives on Steam on June 11!

Imago Season is a true narrative roleplaying experience. Explore an alien city inhabited by human-insect hybrids. Roll dice, join a revolution, become a mutant yourself. What are you willing to do in order to find your truth? The choices are yours, but so are the consequences.
